players.notes: Full name/nickname: Glamour Ghost Gunner (G3). Ghost Armor, Freefaller background (ghost can float freely within FAR of the armor, sucked back in after 1D4 ROUNDS; fully immaterial outside the armor). DEFENSE computed as CON 2 (base) + Ghost Armor life form +2 + Hard Suit +3 + Energy Shield +2 = 9. Stats.CON is the raw base stat (2); an earlier note of 'CON +8' was folding in life-form/loot DEFENSE bonuses that belong on the defense field instead, not the CON stat itself. A WEAPONS & TOOLS effort bonus was mentioned but left unspecified — recorded as 0 here pending confirmation.
